correctness.rationale: Cycle-label transitivity obstruction and positive-subforest refinement establish the support iff criterion. Tree counts give the exact VC rank. A deterministic union-find predictor errs exclusively on target-positive mergers, at most the target rank; a fixed VC-shattered forest yields the equal online lower bound. Positive contractions maintain refinement closure and all negative restrictions. Proper coloring partitions have minimum block count χ(G). Independent exhaustive checks confirm 1099 graph cases through five vertices and 12070 consistent conditional four-vertex cases; finite checks corroborate rather than establish the unrestricted proof.
